title: kith-jmap: JmapHandler doc says 'Handlers must not panic' but gives no guidance on what to do instead
description: lib.rs JmapHandler trait doc (line 264) says 'Handlers must not panic. A panic inside call will propagate through the async executor and crash the task; there is no catch at the dispatch layer.' This is accurate but only states the prohibition, not the remedy. A contributor implementing a new handler doesn't know whether to use unwrap() vs expect() vs returning Err(serverFail). The doc should say: use map_err to convert all error types to JmapError and return Err(JmapError::server_fail(...)) for internal failures. Never unwrap() or expect() unless the invariant is formally proven safe. This prevents the pattern tracked in KITH-hqrw.67 from recurring.
